english.note: This is the all-purpose term for a member of a pastoral society who moves with herds and has no fixed home.

examples.english: On the grasslands, a nomad follows the flock around looking for pasture.
examples.traditional: 喺草原上，遊牧民會跟住羊群周圍搵水草。
